IGUI_SQSF_Ready: Load, enable or recover a resource. This window stays open.
IGUI_SQSF_PumpHint: 1000 per resource. Enable to supply connected pipes.
IGUI_SQSF_SprinklerHint: 200 per resource. Network first; enabled local stock is backup.
IGUI_SQSF_Guard: API changed. Automation disabled; recovery remains available.
IGUI_SQSF_NoSource: No supply: check switches, stock and pipes.
IGUI_SQSF_RetiredHint: Removed device: collect stored materials here.
IGUI_SQSF_Rounding: Recover %1 doses; discard %2 fractional doses. Sprays require enough empty packs/bottles.
IGUI_SQSF_RecoveryHint: Recovery rounds down. Sprays need empty packs or bottles.
IGUI_SQSF_RecipeHint: Crafting: SuQing Irrigation Upgrade · 50/200-dose packs leave reusable empties.
IGUI_SQSF_TooFar: Move closer to operate this device.
IGUI_SQSF_Message_Unavailable: Conditions changed. Move closer and try again.
IGUI_SQSF_Message_Full: Full, or less than one dose of space. Item unchanged.
IGUI_SQSF_Message_LoadedFull: Loaded %1 doses. This resource is now FULL.
IGUI_SQSF_Message_Migrated: Legacy material: loaded %1 doses; discarded %2 fractional doses.
IGUI_SQSF_Message_NeedEmpty: Not enough empty pack/bottle capacity. Stock unchanged.
IGUI_SQSF_Message_NoMaterial: No matching material in inventory. Favorites are excluded.
IGUI_SQSF_NetworkEmpty: No reachable devices. Check pipes and valves.
IGUI_SQSF_InspectHint: Control connected sprinklers at the pump. Load/recover at the target.
IGUI_SQSF_SupplyReady: Supply available; used when crops need care
IGUI_SQSF_SupplyNone: No care supply: check stock and switches
IGUI_SQSF_ViewOnly: Control care and pump input at the pump; load/recover at the target.
IGUI_SQSF_ProjectTip: Controls this care project on the sprinkler. OFF blocks both pump and local stock.
IGUI_SQSF_SupplyTip: Controls pump supply for this resource only. Local stock can still work. Care OFF always prevents treatment.
